# PredictPro — AI Football Predictions

> PredictPro (https://predictpro.guru) is an AI-powered football prediction SaaS. It provides daily match predictions, betting tips, jackpot picks, live scores, and league standings for 40+ competitions worldwide. Predictions are generated by Google Gemini AI and updated every match day. Based in Nairobi, Kenya; serving a global audience.

## Key Pages

- [Home / Today's Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/): Daily AI football predictions, value bets, BTTS tips.
- [Premier League Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/premier-league-predictions): AI tips for all EPL fixtures.
- [Champions League Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/champions-league-predictions): UEFA UCL AI predictions.
- [La Liga Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/la-liga-predictions): Spanish football AI tips.
- [Bundesliga Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/bundesliga-predictions): German football AI tips.
- [Serie A Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/serie-a-predictions): Italian football AI tips.
- [Ligue 1 Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/ligue-1-predictions): French football AI tips.
- [KPL Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/kpl-predictions): Kenya Premier League AI tips.
- [Jackpot Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/jackpot-predictions): Sportpesa Mega Jackpot & Midweek Jackpot AI tips.
- [US Soccer Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/us-soccer-predictions): MLS and US football AI tips.
- [BTTS Tips](https://predictpro.guru/btts): Both-teams-to-score predictions for today's matches.
- [Correct Score Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/correct-score): AI correct score tips.
- [Value Bets](https://predictpro.guru/value-bets): AI-identified value bets with edge over bookmakers.
- [Live Scores](https://predictpro.guru/live-scores): Real-time match scores from 40+ leagues.
- [Standings](https://predictpro.guru/standings): Current league tables and rankings.
- [Upcoming Fixtures](https://predictpro.guru/upcoming): Upcoming matches with early AI predictions.
- [Blog](https://predictpro.guru/blog): Football betting strategy guides, xG analysis, AI insights.
- [Sitemap](https://predictpro.guru/sitemap): Full site index.

## Coverage

40+ leagues including: English Premier League, UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Major League Soccer, Kenya Premier League, Sportpesa Mega Jackpot, AFCON, CAF Champions League, Copa Libertadores, Saudi Pro League, AFC Champions League.

## Accuracy

Predictions claim 87% accuracy. Powered by Google Gemini AI with xG statistics, historical form, head-to-head records, and live odds.

## Content Freshness

- Predictions: updated daily at 02:00 UTC via automated Supabase pipeline
- Blog posts: generated daily at 02:30 UTC
- Standings: refreshed hourly during match weeks
- Live scores: real-time via RapidAPI

## Pricing

Freemium. Free tier includes daily predictions and live scores. Premium plans available via Paystack (card, M-Pesa).

## Technology

Frontend: Vite + React + Tailwind CSS. Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Edge Functions). Hosting: Vercel. AI: Google Gemini Flash. Payments: Paystack. Notifications: Telegram broadcast channel.
